args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money claimed banker's rounding in its docstring and per FIN-212,
but actually used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so ties round
to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66), matching
tests/test_money.py.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix money rounding: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was actually usingROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: change quantization from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so ties round to the nearest even cent (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`), matching the test expectations and FIN-212.

## Testing
Branch `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` passed CI (run `ci-0001`, commit `40806e4668`).
